name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Adversaries may communicate using OSI application layer protocols to avoid detection by blending with existing traffic. Commands to and results from a remote system are embedded within the protocol traffic, using protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, and SMTP that are commonly allowed through firewalls.
detection: Analyze network traffic for uncommon data flows, such as a client making significantly more requests than it receives, or protocol behavior that does not match the expected application. Inspect packet contents for anomalies not conforming to the expected protocol standard.
mitigations: M1037: Filter Network Traffic — proxy and inspect egress
